title: What does this return?
examObjective: Predicting the result of core DataWeave functions
prompt: Read the script and the payload. **What does it return?**

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
ns a urn:x
---
{ plain: payload.order.id, qualified: payload.a#order.a#id }

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
ns a urn:x
---
{ plain: payload.order.id, qualified: payload.a#order.a#id }

explanation.approach: A selector without a namespace matches by local name, whatever namespace the element is in. A qualified selector matches the namespace as well. XML text is always a String.

snippets.label: The answer
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
ns a urn:x
---
{ plain: payload.order.id, qualified: payload.a#order.a#id }
snippets.note: Both find it. Qualify when two namespaces use the same local name.
